title: The Twelve Apostles
intro: Jesus chose twelve men to be his closest disciples. They were to be with him, and he would send them out to preach.

persons.name: Simon Peter
persons.description: Fisherman from Bethsaida, leader among the apostles

persons.name: Andrew
persons.description: Peter's brother, originally a disciple of John the Baptist

persons.name: James
persons.description: Son of Zebedee, brother of John

persons.name: John
persons.description: Son of Zebedee, 'the disciple whom Jesus loved'

persons.name: Philip
persons.description: From Bethsaida, brought Nathanael to Jesus

persons.name: Bartholomew
persons.description: Likely the same person as Nathanael

persons.name: Thaddaeus
persons.description: Also called Judas, son of James

persons.name: Simon the Zealot
persons.description: Former member of the Zealots (resistance movement)

persons.name: Judas Iscariot
persons.description: The betrayer who handed Jesus over
